title: Peumeurintah Nyang Meutuntut Keutuhanan .
intro: Sidroe peunguasa nyang meukuasa dan sombong geupeucaya hana meusidroe pih nyang teudong ateueh takhta awaknyan. Awaknyan jijak peulet saboh kelompok nyang jiplueng di ateuh ie nyang luah, hanya untuk meurumpok akhe nyang dramatis. Kisah peunguasa nyoe meu-gema di le that bagian-bagian Al-Quran, jeut keu peuingat keu mandum.
clues: Lon nakeuh sidroe peunguasa nyang meukuasa nyang peucaya hana otoritas nyang leubeh nibak otoritas lon di nanggroe-nanggroe nyang lon peurintah.
Lon na sidroe wazir nyang lon peucaya nan jih Haman nyang geubantu lon peugot proyek-proyek arsitektur nyang rayeuk.
Ulôn hôi tukang-tukang sihe nyang paleng jroh di nanggroe ulôn keu jijak tantangan tanda-tanda sidroe utusan nyang jilawan ulôn.
Lon hana lontem peubiyeu saboh bansa nyang ka jeuet keu lamiet lam wilayah lon jijak, bahpih na bala dan peringatan nyang jeulaih.
Ulôn tiyeub awaknyan jijeumeurang laôt nyang luwah deungon banmandum pasokan dan geuritan prang ulôn.
Laôt njan keuh njang djitôp ateuëh ulôn dan pasukan ulôn, djipeu-angkèë kamoë bandum, seudangkan awaknjan djilintas deungon seulamat.

Meusaboh lom ngon keuluarga lheuh meuthon-thon susah .

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
